aws_s3.notes: Bucket name is globally unique. If the bucket name is already taken by someone else, it cannot be claimed.

alternative_fingerprints: There isn't a Github Pages site here.
github_pages.notes: Need to ensure the target GitHub username/organization still exists but the Pages site has been deleted.

heroku.notes: Heroku now typically requires domain verification. Fingerprint matching alone is insufficient; additional confirmation of whether the app name can be claimed is needed.

azure_app_service.notes: Azure has domain verification mechanisms; many App Services are protected by TXT records and cannot be directly claimed. The 'edge_case' status reflects this uncertainty.

netlify.notes: Netlify also has domain verification; similar to Azure, it requires manual verification of whether it can be claimed.

surge_sh.notes: Simple static hosting service; fingerprints are clear, and claiming the corresponding project name usually allows takeover.
